subject: Pricing & Budget Alignment - Finex integration (post-call recap)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Michaels <jordan@finex.io>, Priya Raman <priya.raman@finex.io>
Cc: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 03 Jun 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Pricing & Budget Alignment - Finex integration (post-call recap)

Thanks again for taking the time today - appreciate the clear context on the integration and expected traffic patterns. Quick recap and a few next asks so we can put together a formal estimate:

Call recap (high level)
- Use case: real-time personalization + search re-rank for end-user queries (customer-facing).
- Current traffic: ~10k queries/day, expected to grow to 80-100k queries/day over next 6-9 months.
- Avg prompt+response length: ~1.2k tokens (combined).
- Latency target: p95 <= 500ms for interactive flows.

Pricing / volume info we need to confirm
1) Expected monthly token volume (prompt + generated tokens) at target scale (best guess): you mentioned 80-100k queries/day, which maps to ~3.0-3.6B tokens/month. Please confirm if that aligns with your internal forecast.
2) Budget range: do you have a monthly or annual budget range for inference (order of magnitude helps - e.g., $Xk-$Yk / month or $A-$B / year)?
3) Economic buyer & finance sign-off: who in your org signs off on platform spend for this project? We heard Priya might be the approver but wanted to confirm.
4) Target unit economics: is there an internal target for cost per 1M tokens or target TCO for this feature (e.g., $/1M tokens target)? If you have a target $/1M tokens we can align recommendations to that (quantization, batching, Dedicated vs Hosted).

Next steps from our side
- I'll pull together a short estimate with 3 pricing scenarios (Hosted pay-as-you-go, 12mo committed Dedicated tier, Dedicated + support) and an expected $/1M tokens range.
- I'll loop in Lukas (SE) for a short follow-up to confirm inference config (sequence length, batching, KV cache strategy).
- If you can confirm (1) monthly token estimate and (2) who the budget owner / approver is, we can get a formal proposal to you by end of week.

Attachment: redwood_pricing_estimate_v2.pdf (draft - numbers based on today's call)

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192

From: Jordan Michaels <jordan@finex.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Raman <priya.raman@finex.io>, Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 04 Jun 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing & Budget Alignment - Finex integration (post-call recap)

Thanks Marissa - helpful recap. A few quick answers and clarifications from our side:

- Monthly token estimate: current prod is small (~300M tokens/month) but roadmap puts us at ~3.2B tokens/month in 6 months (your calc is in the right range). We'll plan for a light buffer and use ~3.5B tokens/month for budgeting.
- Budget range: initial pilot budget for Q3 is ~$25k-$35k/month. If the pilot meets KPIs we have budget to scale up (TBD during Q4 planning).
- Economic buyer: Priya Raman (VP Finance) is the approver for platform-level spend >$20k/mo - I've CC'd her here.
- Target unit economics: we don't have a strict $/1M target, but ideally below $1k per 1M tokens fully loaded. If you can show options that hit ~$700-$900 / 1M tokens that will be competitive for the pilot.

Can you include an expected breakdown of token price vs infra (GPU-hours) vs support in the estimate? Also note that procurement will want to see a 12mo committed price if we're going to consider reserved capacity.

- Jordan
Director, Product
Finex Analytics
jordan@finex.io

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Raman <priya.raman@finex.io>, Jordan Michaels <jordan@finex.io>
Cc: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 04 Jun 2026 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing & Budget Alignment - Finex integration (post-call recap)

Great - thanks for the clarity, Jordan. Priya, thanks for joining on the thread (copying finance). Quick note on how we'll present the economics so procurement & finance have the inputs they need:

What we'll include in the formal proposal
- 3 scenarios with clear $/1M token ranges: Hosted PAYG, 12mo Committed Dedicated (discounted), and Dedicated + Premium Support (SLA + faster scale).
- Unit economics breakout: token price, estimated GPU infra amortized per 1M tokens, ops/support allocation, and expected network/storage. We'll show a blended $/1M tokens and the raw token-only rate.
- Break-even examples: given your ~3.5B tokens/mo forecast, we'll show monthly totals and annualized spend.

Preliminary numbers (draft / illustrative)
- Hosted PAYG: ~$1,050 / 1M tokens (includes model and runtime overhead)
- 12mo Committed (Dedicated): ~$720 / 1M tokens (with a 20-30% discount depending on commit and quantization profile)
- Dedicated + Premium Support: ~$800 / 1M tokens (better predictability + 24/7 SRE on-call)

These are draft - see attached redwood_pricing_estimate_v2.pdf for the line items and assumptions. Lukas, if you can weigh in on the quantization and batching savings we can tighten the committed numbers further.

asks for Finex
- Can Priya confirm she's comfortable being listed as the budget owner and approver for $20k+/mo?
- Would procurement want a 12mo contract or explore a 6mo stepped-commit first?

Proposed next steps
1) Priya confirms budget owner & preferred contract length (6mo stepped or 12mo commit).
2) We set a 30-45 minute follow-up with Lukas to finalize inference configuration (sequence length, batching).
3) We'll deliver a formal proposal + sample SOW for procurement review by EOD Friday (June 5).

Thanks - I’ll stand by for Priya's confirmation and will update the HubSpot deal.

Best,
Marissa

From: Priya Raman <priya.raman@finex.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jordan Michaels <jordan@finex.io>
Cc: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 05 Jun 2026 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing & Budget Alignment - Finex integration (post-call recap)

Confirming - I'm the budget owner for this initiative and will be the sign-off for spend > $20k/mo. For the pilot we prefer a 6mo stepped-commit (gives us flexibility through Q4 planning).

A few procurement asks up front:
- Please include a short appendix with security/compliance bullet points (SOC 2, data retention controls, VPC options) in the proposal so procurement can fast-track the review.
- Can you surface a 12mo committed price as an optional line item (we may convert if pilot goes well).

Marissa / Lukas - if you can get the formal proposal + the security appendix and the committed/optional line item over by EOD today (June 5) that would be ideal. Jordan and I will review and route to procurement.

Thanks - Priya Raman
